doc: <doc> (the source of every value; edit there first)
note: v6 (2026-09-27 14:05): yellow = the TARGET temperature Adaptive aims for; red = yellow + 1; Emergency = yellow + 2 (its own category, handled by the Emergency path and shown only as the pop-up), clearing at yellow (the owner: "Emergency clears at yellow, not green"). Kinds without Emergency (CPU: throttles itself) use tune = [yellow, yellow - 1]. Inlet is informational only. hosts.<host>.<kind> overrides any field. Sources: server-component-thermal-catalog.md. "fans": false = display only (2026-09-28: inlet, CPU and pkg are shown and coloured but never set fan speed). "aim" on a kind sets the fan-control aim directly (cpu: hub 98, GPU server 85).

cpu.label: CPU package (coretemp / iDRAC CPU)
cpu.detail: hub Xeon E5-2690 v4: yellow 98 / red 99 (display; +2 from 96/97, 2026-09-28). Fan aim 98°C (2026-09-28: "add back CPU to the fan control, maybe just with a higher setting"); measured throttling starts at about 100°C (package 1 throttled 11% of the time at 100–102°C while display-only). TjMax 103. No Emergency.

gpu.label: GPU (RTX 2080 Ti)
gpu.detail: RTX 2080 Ti (Dell OEM). Yellow 90 / red 91 / Emergency 92 (clears at 90); control aim 89 (2026-09-27: yellow 87 was reverted because the GPU's aim is what pulls in the case fans). Card fan 100% while busy (a 90% test throttled at 88°C); spike guard at aim + 1 (90°C) or a firmware reading > 100%.

nvme.label: NVMe SSD
nvme.detail: Samsung 990 PRO warns at 82°C (throttles); Acer N3500 at 90°C. The stricter 990 PRO value is used for both.

ssd.label: WD Red SA500 SATA SSD
ssd.detail: WD Red SA500 4 TB. Max 70°C (the owner's research and WD's datasheet; the drive's SMART says 65). 70 is yellow, 71 red.

toshiba.label: Toshiba MG03SCA400 SAS HDD
toshiba.detail: Toshiba MG03SCA400 SAS. Rated 5–55°C; the drive trips at 50°C. Degraded RAID 5: the most fragile disks. Yellow 47 / red 48 / Emergency 49 (clears at 47): +1°C for all profiles (2026-09-28, so the drive bays hold Adaptive's fans lower); Emergency now sits 1°C under the 50°C trip.

exhaust.label: Exhaust (iDRAC)
exhaust.detail: Air leaving the chassis; proxy for unsensed rear parts. No Dell exhaust spec; iDRAC warning 70 / critical 75. Yellow 62 / red 63 / Emergency 63 (clears at 62), fan aim 61 (2026-09-28 15:30).

inlet.label: Inlet (iDRAC)
inlet.detail: Room air in. Informational only: fans can't lower it. Yellow at 35°C, red from 36°C on both servers (2026-09-27: this room runs this warm; Dell's 35°C, and 30°C for the GPU server with a GPU, are noted but not enforced).

gpu_fan_pct.label: GPU card fan, % of full speed
gpu_fan_pct.detail: Card fan, % of 6,030 rpm. Over 100% means the firmware is overriding: the card is too hot.

raid.label: RAID controller chip (PERC ROC)
raid.detail: PERC H730 (hub, LSI SAS3108) / H710 Mini (GPU server, SAS2208), read with perccli every 60 s. LSI/Intel: the ROC is designed to run below 105°C, throttles at 110, stops I/O at 116. Yellow 95 leaves margin (the hub controller faulted 2026-09-27).

cpu.detail: GPU server Xeon E5-2695 v2: yellow 85 / red 86 (display; +2 from 83/84, 2026-09-28). Fan aim 85°C, 2°C under TjMax 87 (2026-09-28). No Emergency.
